escalations.title: proxy-addr IPv4-Mapped IPv6 IP Spoofing
escalations.impact: Authentication bypass via IP spoofing when running behind a proxy or load balancer. Attacker can forge trusted IP by sending IPv4-mapped IPv6 address.

escalations.title: Tinypool Remote Code Execution via Prototype Pollution
escalations.impact: Remote Code Execution via prototype pollution in test worker pool. Any CI job running `vitest` is vulnerable.
escalations.fix: npm audit fix --force in Source/Frontend (→ vitest 5.0.5)

escalations.title: Handlebars.js JavaScript Injection — Multiple Gadgets
escalations.impact: AST type confusion, template injection, and prototype pollution in Handlebars allow arbitrary code execution in the Jest test runner.

backlog.title: Traceability Enforcer Blind to 87% of Spec Requirements
backlog.impact: CI gate exits PASSED while 96 of 109 spec requirements receive zero automated coverage verification. False green on every CI run.

backlog.title: Direct DB Calls in Portal Route Handlers
backlog.impact: Architecture rule violated. Route handlers cannot be unit-tested without a real DB. Any db initialization change requires modifying route handlers.
backlog.recommendation: Create teamDispatchService.ts. Move db.prepare() calls into service layer.

backlog.title: 174 console.* Calls in Platform Orchestrator — No Logger Abstraction

backlog.recommendation: Solo session: introduce logger.js in platform/orchestrator/lib/ and replace all console.* calls.
backlog.note: platform/ is solo-session only per CLAUDE.md
